description: This file contains tests and stub implementations for vector memory handling, including setting, retrieving, deleting vectors, and similarity search. It also includes HTTP handlers for these operations implemented using Gin framework.

methods.name: SetVectorHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for setting a vector record, storing embedding and metadata in the vector storage.

methods.name: GetVectorHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for retrieving a vector record by key, considering scope from headers or query parameters.

methods.name: DeleteVectorHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for deleting a vector record, supporting RESTful and legacy POST requests.

methods.name: SimilaritySearchHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for performing similarity search on vectors, returning top K results based on query embedding.
